note: Giant units that stay whole because they are reasonable as one unit (user 2026-10-25: a reasonable oversized unit is not force-split, it is marked; specs/repository-anti-corruption §4.5; the list with every verdict is docs/system/HUGE-CLASS-MIGRATION.md). Each entry has a kind, a reason that says why splitting it would be wrong, and "size": the measured size (lines for a file or a function, { lines, methods } for a class), which has to equal what the gate measures, so an entry reserves no headroom and growth shows as an edit here. A unit with a valid entry is admitted by the merge-base comparison, new or grown; a giant unit without one may not appear or grow. Keys are the unit keys of baseline.json; an entry for a unit that is no longer giant fails the gate and has to be deleted. kind: translation-table, stylesheet, static-data, generated-code or cohesive-unit (one responsibility that splitting would scatter: a state machine, a parser, a protocol adapter). A unit that mixes several jobs is split, not marked. Edits here are reviewed like edits to the gate.

class packages/plugin-runtime/src/index..reason: PluginRuntime 是插件安装的生命周期状态机：安装、启动、停止、升级、回退、改授权都在同一把安装锁、同一份撤权世代和同一个记录库下串行；拆到类外要把锁、记录库和撤权的私有入口全部公开，一致性反而散到类外。它是内聚单元，按例外登记（W5-10 判定为内聚例外），不是待拆的债。PG-002 新增的 regrant 在类里只是一个转交方法，步骤在 regrant.ts；类不再变大，往后新增的逻辑写在新文件里。

file plugins/official-integrations/catal.reason: 39 个连接器的声明表：CATALOG 数组本身 834 行，每条独立，只描述该连接器的身份请求与条目映射；数组之外约 180 行是条目用的构造、解析与连接器专属请求头助手。条目之间没有逻辑联系，按行数拆不会让任何一条更好改。保持一个单元时继续只承载连接器声明；大小变动须同步实测 size 交评审，混入别的职责时按职责拆。
